variants.candidate: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Earth makes it steady, so you stay put when pushed. Running thin, the stand gives early, and you borrow a peer's certainty or drop a shared stake rather than fight. You keep only what you held on your own.
variants.original: Earth is your Body, and running thin, it is the steadiness under everything: digestion, sleep depth, the physical calm that lets you carry weight. Yours erodes quietly under skipped meals and moved bedtimes.

variants.candidate: Your Order is the rules you answer to and the rank you hold by them. Wood makes it grow, a standard rising with you. As a catalyst, you lack a demand to meet, so you chase a crisis or a career someone else planned and finish less of your own.
variants.original: Wood is your Order, and as a catalyst, it is living obligation that keeps you growing: family, teams, mentees, commitments that grow back each season and ask you to grow with them. Care is your discipline.

variants.candidate: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Water makes it flow, so what you claim comes by moving. As a catalyst, your Action is slow to begin. You keep what you saved rather than chase what you see, and the chance closes while you wait.
variants.original: Water is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is moving value passing through your steady hands: money, opportunities, people in motion who need somewhere reliable to land. You profit by being the stable point in a moving system.

variants.candidate: Your Mind is where the world soaks in and becomes yours. Fire makes it warm, and you keep what lights you up. As a catalyst, you stay unlit, chasing one strange idea alone as much as waiting for a kind teacher. Until then you know less than you saw.
variants.original: Fire is your Mind, and as a catalyst, it is how learning actually enters you: through excitement, people, and live example rather than cold text. You retain what warmed you. Affection, praise, and festivity all count as study.

variants.candidate: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Metal makes it exact, each thing finished before it leaves you. As a catalyst, the gate opens too seldom. You finish for yourself ahead of giving, you keep the clever remark unsaid, and you are known for steadiness alone.
variants.original: Metal is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is your patience surfacing as precision: the exact word, the finished piece, the standard people quote after you leave. You speak rarely and it lands.
